text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out, Sakura Bakushin O and I decide to get some food before heading back. However…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! There's actually a place I wanna take you to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, I let Sakura Bakushin O take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to this! The inn's premium course is famous for its all-you-can-eat crab dishes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh ho, it looks like you've become all fidgety with excitement yourself!
choice_data_list: N-no… I was just wondering if they'll take credit…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: He he he… don't worry! You're my VIP today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The other day I came across an elderly lady curled up in pain, and so I took her to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It turns out she was the owner of this place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As a thank-you, she invited me to visit and said I could bring someone important along with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So don't worry! Just enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moved by Sakura Bakushin O's words, I relax as I wait for each dish to come out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hooo! It's SO good! Each dish tastes so high-class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How is it? Delicious, right? Isn't the flavor life-changing?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Onto the main dish! Is what I wanna say, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's one of those fancy crabs served up in its entirety! And… I'm not good at opening up seafood that's presented like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Like, the meat is totally inaccessible! Hiding inside that spiky shell! How cowardly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …True, carefully taking the shell off the crab is troublesome work for a hasty girl like her.
choice_data_list: It's easy to do with the right tools.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Perseverance! That makes sense! Perseverance helps overcome all obstacles!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Perseverance is a model student's specialty! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnngg! Bakushin perseveeerance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SNAP! CRACK!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… I somehow managed to break open the shell.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh! Yes, this is the perseverance of a model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here you go! While you're eating, I'll free another crab from its shell!
choice_data_list: I can do it myself though?
I can do it myself though?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No, no! I decided I want you to thoroughly enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stirred by Sakura Bakushin O's offer, I decide to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …The broken shards of crab shell do hurt my tongue, but eating together is a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That meal was so good!
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me have my fill.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My pleasure! It was thanks to your words that I was able to persevere and defeat those crabs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You always motivate me like that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If you were one of my classmates, I would scout you to be the vice class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! This is how you must've felt when you scouted me, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I see, I see! No need to get bashful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The banquet leaves us with full stomachs and full hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pass her a special spoon for eating crab.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooh? To think such a durable crab can be dismantled so easily!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Leave the de-shelling to me! Please sit back and enjoy the meat, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I can do it myself though?
I can do it myself though?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No, no! I decided I want you to thoroughly enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stirred by Sakura Bakushin O's offer, I decide to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch! Ah, the next crab has arrived! And what a bulky boy! BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her moving swiftly and dexterously to dismantle the crabs, we wind up consuming a large amount of food, but we do so happily…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was some good food!
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me have my fill.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm the one who should be thankful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I've gained another Bakushin-related skill!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please teach me lots of things from now on! And…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As someone important to me, help make my Bakushin bigger and better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The banquet leaves us with full stomachs and refreshed spirits.
